McpDefer.description: Per-server override for deferring MCP tool schemas behind `tool_search`.

oneOf.description: Defer behind `tool_search` when MCP schemas exceed 10% of the context budget.
Always keep this server's tools behind `tool_search`.
Always offer this server's tools directly in the model's tool list.

McpOAuth.description: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE configuration for a remote streamable-HTTP MCP server.

authorization_server.description:
Override the authorization server issuer URL instead of discovering it via
RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata (`/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`).

client_id.description:
Pre-registered OAuth client ID. Omit to use RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration
when the authorization server advertises `registration_endpoint`.

client_secret.description: Optional client secret for confidential clients.

enabled.description: Enable OAuth sign-in for this server (default true when `[oauth]` is present).

redirect_port.description: Preferred loopback port on `127.0.0.1` for the OAuth redirect callback.

scopes.description: Scopes to request; defaults to scopes advertised by the resource/auth server.

McpSamplingModel.description: Model used to serve a server's `sampling/createMessage` requests.

oneOf.description: Use `[model] small` when configured, falling back to the session model.

allow.description: Only these tools (globs on the tool name). Empty: all.

auto_approve.description:
Run these without asking (globs; `["*"]` for all). Others ask, unless the permission
mode or an `mcp:` allow rule says otherwise.

anyOf.description: Plain value. Allowed, but warns when the file is world-readable or inside a repo.

format.description: Format string with `{}` for the value, e.g. `"Bearer {}"`.

anyOf.description: Command whose trimmed stdout is the secret. Only honoured from system, user or trusted project layers.

OS credential store entry `"<service>/<user>"`, or `"<user>"` under the
`quack` service. Store one with `quack keyring set <name>`.

Secret.description: A secret value. Secrets never have to be written into TOML in plain text.

command.description:
Program to start (a server on this machine, over stdio). Found on `PATH`, including
`.cmd` files on Windows.

cwd.description: Working directory; default: the workspace root.

defer.description: Controls whether this server's tools are deferred behind `tool_search`.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server; values may be secrets.

inherit_env.description:
Variables passed through from the harness's own environment. Default: a minimal set
(`PATH`, `HOME`, temp and locale variables, and what Windows needs).

max_output_tokens.description:
Longer results are cut, keeping the start and the end (and saving the full output
to a file when a spill directory is configured).

oauth.description: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE sign-in for a remote HTTP server (`quack mcp login <id>`).

sampling_model.description: Which model answers this server's `sampling/createMessage` requests.

sandbox.description: Run a local server inside the OS sandbox (see `[sandbox]` in config.toml).

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a remote server (instead of `command`).
